title: Diplomacy Rider and Minister of Peace prompts
description: Two prompts that did not say enough. (1) System questions (Diplomacy Rider, Warfare Rider, Umbat, Stymie, Sever, Scepter, ASN, ...) listed bare system ids; the Diplomacy Rider's did not show what the card does. Every option is now named by its planets ('System 25 · Quann (2/1)', 'System 41 · gravity rift, no planets'), the rider's printed text is above the list, and the systems are picked on the map like Diplomacy's. (2) Minister of Peace's offer (discard to end the active player's turn) is a card: the law as printed, the system that was activated named by its planets, who activated it, and a switch like Aetherpassage's (checkbox in the offer, Prompts control on the owner's sheet, auto-decline with a toast). Mocked game with the engine's payload shapes; regenerate with npm run screenshots -- GH. The before shots are the base commit 80ce1bf1 with the same scenes.

notes.title: Display only
notes.text: The engine asks the same questions with the same option ids. Minister of Peace's question gains display details (the law card, the activated system and activator); option ids, subtype and hashes are unchanged. No rules-version change.

notes.title: Toggle
notes.text: Storage key player_ask_minister_of_peace in this browser. The engine still asks; a paused offer is an ordinary recorded decline. The ministers of War and Commerce, Imperial Arbiter and Committee Formation share the question type, so their offers now also show their card, but are not toggleable.
